# 關於運行 LVHI Brigand 穿梭機的提示 - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold] (kW) 為 [color=#a4885c]35 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - There are two buttons in the cockpit: the one with a yellow and black frame controls the window shutters. 帶有灰色邊框的按鈕用於控制迷你錨點。
